item.title: New method reuses ProviderTarget

cases.rationale: ANC-008 v3 statement: related values passed to several methods are grouped in one struct that replaces those repeated parameters. The new method receives the already-grouped values through the existing struct instead of repeating them, which is the pass-fixture pattern (methods taking endpoint, model and timeout take one ProviderTarget) applied to a new method; the quote's aim (minimize repeated code as the architecture scales) is served. Stated explicitly, so addressed=yes; nothing repeats or un-groups the values, so contradicted=no; it adds a method signature in sc-agent code, so relevant=yes.
